title: Project Co-Ordinator
jobDescription:
Project Manager – Robotics Programs (Kick-off to Launch) Company: Unbox Robotics Labs Pvt. Ltd. Experience: 5–8 years Education (Mandatory): B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electronics, Robotics, or Mechatronics Engineering Role Type: Full-time, individual contributor with cross-functional ownership About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds next-generation mobile robotic sortation systems that transform parcel and e-commerce fulfillment operations. Our solutions are deployed across India and international markets, helping logistics and supply-chain leaders achieve faster throughput in smaller footprints. We are looking for a Project Manager who can own customer programs end-to-end — from kick-off through site deployment and go-live — across geographies. Role Summary The Project Manager will be the single point of accountability for delivering robotics deployment projects on time, on budget, and to spec. The role spans the full project lifecycle — requirements freeze, engineering coordination, manufacturing, logistics, site readiness, installation, commissioning, customer acceptance, and handover to operations. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering (Mech / Electrical / Software / Controls), Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Field Service, and external customer stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Program Ownership (Kick-off to Launch) Lead end-to-end execution of customer projects from contract signoff to operational go-live and warranty handover. Define project charter, scope, deliverables, milestones, RACI, and acceptance criteria with internal and customer stakeholders. Drive Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), commissioning, and ramp-up plans. Planning & Execution Build and maintain detailed project plans, critical path, resource loading, risk register, and dependency tracking. Coordinate cross-functional teams across mechanical, electrical, controls, software, manufacturing, and supply chain to meet integrated milestones. Manage change requests, scope creep, and engineering change orders with impact analysis on cost, schedule, and quality. Customer & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary customer-facing PM during execution; run weekly status reviews, steering committee updates, and escalations. Manage international customers and partners across time zones — including travel to project sites for kick-off, FAT, installation, and go-live as required. Risk, Cost & Quality Track project P&L, budget burn, and margin protection; flag deviations early. Identify, assess, and mitigate technical, schedule, supply, and site-related risks. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards relevant to the deployment geography. Reporting & Governance Maintain project dashboards, MIS, and executive reports for internal leadership and customer leadership. Drive lessons-learned reviews and feed improvements back into the playbook. Must-Have Qualifications

EDUCATION:
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical / Electronics / Robotics / Mechatronics Engineering. Experience: 5–8 years managing engineering or product-deployment projects, with a clear track record of owning projects from kick-off through launch . International exposure : Hands-on experience delivering at least one project for an international customer or site — including managing cross-border logistics, time-zone coordination, customer cultural nuances, and on-site execution abroad. Domain: Experience in robotics, industrial automation, warehouse automation, material handling, capital equipment, EV, or comparable hardware-plus-software systems where mechanical, electrical, and software disciplines converge. PM tooling: Working proficiency in project management and collaboration tools — MS Project / Primavera P6 / Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, MS Excel (advanced), Power BI or equivalent dashboards. Familiarity with PLM/ERP touchpoints is a plus. PM methodology: Strong grounding in project management frameworks (Waterfall, Agile/Hybrid, Stage-Gate). PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification preferred. Engineering literacy: Ability to read mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and system architecture documents well enough to challenge engineering teams and unblock the customer. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies Communication: Crisp written and verbal English; able to switch register between shop-floor technicians, customer CXOs, and internal engineering leads. Comfortable presenting to international senior stakeholders. Ownership & Bias for Action: Treats the project as their own business; drives closure rather than tracking status. Stakeholder Influence: Manages by influence across functions where you don't have direct authority. Problem-Solving Under Pressure: Stays composed during commissioning, go-live, and escalation scenarios. Customer Empathy: Understands that the customer's success is the project's success; manages expectations honestly. Cultural Intelligence: Works effectively across geographies and cultures. Detail Orientation with Big-Picture Judgement: Knows what to escalate, what to absorb, and what to delegate. Good to Have Experience with mobile robots, AMRs, AGVs, conveyor or sortation systems. Exposure to warehouse / 3PL / e-commerce / parcel & post customers. Experience with hardware NPI (New Product Introduction) and pilot-to-scale transitions. Working knowledge of safety standards (CE, UL, ISO 13849, IEC 60204) relevant to industrial automation.

title: IT Admin — Function Lead
jobDescription:
IT Admin — Function Lead Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India | Work: HQ, Pune | Department: Information Technology | Reporting : CTO | Experience: 8+ years (including team / function leadership) About Unbox Robotics Unbox Robotics builds cutting-edge robotics and automation that is transforming warehousing and logistics. Our systems help some of the fastest-growing supply chains move faster, sort smarter, and scale without limits. As our team and infrastructure grow, reliable and secure IT is foundational to everything we ship — and that is exactly where this role comes in. Role Purpose The IT Admin Function Lead owns and governs IT administration across the organization and all its locations. You will be accountable for reliable, secure, and standardized IT services — end-user systems, servers, endpoints, access, and IT operations — and for the processes, documentation, and controls that keep them audit-ready as the company scales. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will set the standard for how IT administration runs at Unbox: lead and grow the IT Administration team, enforce SOPs and least-privilege access, drive full traceability of changes, and coordinate closely with the Security and Networking / Infrastructure functions. Key Responsibilities
1. IT Administration & Operations Management Own and govern day-to-day IT administration activities across all locations. Ensure the availability and performance of end-user systems, servers, and IT services. Define and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all IT administration tasks. Coordinate with vendors for IT support, licensing, and service delivery.
2. User, Endpoint & Device Management Govern user provisioning and de-provisioning, and set the standard for employee onboarding and offboarding end to end. Define endpoint configuration standards for laptops, desktops, and peripherals. Oversee OS builds, patching, EDR/antivirus deployment, and system hardening. Manage the fleet through MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, and Manage Engine . Ensure asset tagging, lifecycle management, and disposal compliance.
3. Access Control & Privilege Management Govern administrative access and enforce least-privilege principles across systems. Ensure privileged access is granted only with proper approval and documentation. Run a Privileged Access Management (PAM) program and coordinate with Security on access reviews and audits. Maintain accurate records of admin access, temporary permissions, and approvals.
4. Infrastructure & Application Support Coordinate with infrastructure and networking teams on server, storage, and network dependencies. Ensure availability and support for business applications and internal tools. Manage application installations through approved, controlled processes. Oversee endpoint and application licensing compliance.
5. IT Service Management & Reporting Ensure all IT activity is tracked through ITSM tickets, email trails, and documentation — no ad-hoc or undocumented work. Monitor SLAs and ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests. Maintain daily and weekly status reporting for management review. Keep full traceability across every change and request.
6. Security, Audit & Compliance Maintain audit-ready documentation for IT administration, and support internal and external audits (IT, security, compliance). Drive closure of audit points and corrective actions within defined timelines. Keep IT policies, SOPs, and checklists current. Coordinate with the security team and specialist vendors across DLP, web security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), cloud security, server & endpoint backup, and continuous threat exposure management (red teaming).
7. Team Leadership & Coordination Lead and mentor the IT Administration team; assign clear ownership, timelines, and reporting. Review team performance and uphold professional, disciplined work practices. Act as the escalation point for complex IT administration issues. Coordinate closely with the Cyber Security and Networking / Infrastructure leads.
8. Business Continuity & Improvement Support business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster-recovery activities. Identify gaps in IT administration processes and drive continuous improvement. Recommend automation and standardization to improve efficiency and strengthen security posture. Key Accountabilities Stable and secure IT administration operations. Zero undocumented changes or access. Timely incident and request resolution within SLA. Accurate, timely reporting to management. Audit-compliant IT administration processes. Requirements Must Have 8+ years in IT Administration, System Administration, or IT Operations, including 2+ years leading a team or function. Strong Windows and Linux administration. Endpoint management and patching at scale, with hands-on experience across MDM / UEM (Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or Manage Engine) and EDR/antivirus. IT asset management, and application and license management. Hands-on experience with ITSM tools and ticketing systems, and SLA-driven service delivery. Identity and access governance across Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace and Saa S tools, including privileged access management. Proven vendor and stakeholder management. Strong documentation, process discipline, and audit-readiness. Clear leadership, coordination, reporting, and escalation skills. Good to Have ITIL certification and relevant system or security certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Jamf, Comp TIA). Experience standing up and scaling IT in a startup, high-growth, or multi-entity (India + overseas) environment. Experience supporting audits in a regulated, high-governance, or pre-IPO context. Exposure to security tooling — DLP, Zero Trust / SSE, WAF, cloud security, PAM, and CTEM / red-teaming programs. Scripting or automation for IT operations. Qualification Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field. Tools & Environment You'll Govern You will own (and coordinate with the Security and Networking functions and specialist vendors on) a modern IT and security stack, including: Device & endpoint: MDM / UEM (Jamf, Intune, Manage Engine), endpoint security / EDR, antivirus, and patch management. Identity & access: Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace, Saa S access management, MFA, and Privileged Access Management (PAM). Service & operations: ITSM / ticketing, infrastructure monitoring and alerting, and server & endpoint backup. Data & network security: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Web Security (Zero Trust / SSE), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and cloud security. Assurance: continuous threat exposure management / red teaming. Workplace: meeting-room AV and conferencing — screens, cameras, wireless presentation, and room scheduling for Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and Webex. What We Value Ownership and accountability — leading by example. A strong customer-service mindset across the organization. Process and documentation discipline, and a bias for traceability. Proactive, pragmatic problem-solving. Raising the bar on IT reliability and security posture. Adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a habit of continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Technology is at the core of everything we do. As the IT Admin Function Lead, you will own and shape the IT backbone that keeps every team productive and secure — and build the standards, controls, and team that let it scale as Unbox enters its next phase of growth. Your work will directly underpin the reliability, security, and governance of the entire organization.
